name: Restore a temporary barrier over a wound
description: Cover an open wound with a dressing, allograft or temporary substitute that limits fluid loss and contamination until definitive repair.

grade.note: Occlusive dressings, cadaveric allograft and synthetic temporary substitutes are routine burn and wound care. Temporary is the operative word: none of these regenerates the skin beneath them.
